tagline: A bed and breakfast in Midigama, on Sri Lanka’s south coast.
closing: Live dates are on Booking.com, and groups can rent the whole house on Airbnb. To ask Ashly something first, call.

copyBlocks.heading: Around the courtyard
copyBlocks.body:
Sea You is a white house of two storeys. Downstairs, room doors with carved fanlights open onto an inner courtyard, with a cushioned bench and potted plants.

Upstairs, the balconies look out over the garden to the coconut palms. There are tables and chairs out there, and a settee with green cushions on the long balcony.

copyBlocks.heading: Ashly
copyBlocks.body:
Your host is Ashly. He is a Superhost on Airbnb, and he usually answers messages there within a few hours.

In his own words: “Whether you’re chasing the perfect wave, soaking up the beach vibes, or just looking to unwind, our place is your perfect home away from home.”

copyBlocks.heading: Seven rooms
copyBlocks.body:
There are seven double rooms, sleeping fourteen guests between them. Only one has air conditioning; the other six do not. Airbnb rates are for a room without it, so if you want the air-conditioned room, ask when you book.

The rooms share a look: a four-poster double bed painted mint green, a teal velvet throw, a timber towel ladder and a green cabinet with a mirror.

copyBlocks.heading: Breakfast
copyBlocks.body: Breakfast is Asian, with local specialities, warm dishes, juice and fruit.

copyBlocks.heading: Carved doors and a surfboard shower
copyBlocks.body:
The front door is a carved grey double door, with a carved wooden chair beside it. Further in, carved wooden masks hang by a doorway among the ferns.

In the garden, a shower is built into a wooden surfboard fixed to the wall under the palms, for rinsing off after the sea.

copyBlocks.heading: Finding the house
copyBlocks.body:
Booking.com lists the house under Kumbalgama, and Airbnb under Matara. Both are this house, in Midigama.

Booking.com puts Midigama railway station 950 m away on foot, and Weligama Beach 3.4 km.

spot: The house’s own line: “Hello to waves in a minute walk.”

rooms.label: Deluxe Double Room
rooms.note: 13 m², with its own bathroom, a private entrance, a terrace and a balcony.

rooms.label: Standard Double Room
rooms.note: 12 m², with a private entrance and a wardrobe.

stayInfo.note: Children of any age are welcome; there are no cots or extra beds. Pets on request, and charges may apply. No parties or events.

testimonials.quote: We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and price! Private balcony outside of rooms. The host is extremely responsive and helpful. Let us check in sooner, was able to book an additional night, recommend where to get laundry done & sorted an airport transfer for us! Highly recommend staying here
testimonials.author: Niamh

testimonials.quote:
We had a great stay! Ashly was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and very accomodating. The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is amazing, just steps away from the sea and restaurants. 
We would definitely recommend staying here!
testimonials.author: Kenza

testimonials.quote: I had a very pleasant stay at this place. For the paid price, the room were absolutely good value and met my expectations. Outside, there is a lovely and well-maintained patio area, which is very nice to relax in. Ashley, the owner, is truly fantastic, very kind, attentive, and always ready to help with anything you might need. He really makes you feel welcome and well taken care of.
testimonials.author: Marina, Italy

testimonials.quote: Amazing location in Midigama. Great place to stay, would recommend

testimonials.quote: It was a nice place to stay. Would recommend to go there.
